data.name: Hessian Landing
data.detailed_description:
“Now here’s something very few people ever get to do in their lifetimes: to set foot on a new world.” — Conrad von Dehling, Nova-Hessian Commander

Hessian Landing: A slow-burn descent from Prussia-Punk colony into cosmic horror madness — the Maroon heroine signals the Frog People with a vital tongue gesture — bridging worlds on the edge of the unknown.

Hessian Landing is in active development. Early preview — major upgrades ahead: refined combat, traversal, new critters & biomes. Wishlist to follow the journey!

A decade after the Nova-Hessian colonists arrived, the frontier world of Eden teeters on the edge of turmoil. As Cal, a young Aquila woman born on Eden, you must navigate rising tensions, unravel a growing mystery, and decide the fate of a fractured colony.

This is a seamless, handcrafted open-world, third-person Adventure RPG focused on exploration, quests, real-time skill-based combat, and dialogue-driven choices. Your decisions influence faction relations and shape the course of a branching sci-fi mystery.

Features:

  • Third-person Adventure RPG set in a unique sci-fi frontier world

  • Melee and ranged combat with tomahawks, wingsticks, and flintlock pistols

  • Dialogue-driven narrative with branching paths

  • Explore towns, wilderness, underground sewers, and ancient catacombs

  • Shape a living frontier culture as factions compete for power

Setting:

Two centuries ago, Eden became home to stranded space freebooters whose descendants now live in a quasi–stone-age society, clinging to fading fragments of lost technology.

A decade ago, a second wave of settlers arrived —this time with a fully equipped colony ship and a vision for a new civilization. Since then, tensions have escalated.

Cryptic off-world messages fuel secretive cults, a mysterious mind-altering drug spreads through the colony, and the enigmatic Frog People—Eden’s indigenous hominids—exert their own unpredictable influence.

Caught between these forces, Cal must rely on diplomacy, trade, deception—or force—to prevent the colony from tearing itself apart.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit) or newer
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 or AMD Ryzen 5 (quad-core or better)
  • Memory: 8 MB RAM
  • Graphics: AMD RDNA 2–class GPU or equivalent
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX-compatible sound device
  • Additional Notes: Runs at 60 FPS on Steam Deck with low to medium settings. OpenGL 4.3 required (via Windows graphics drivers)

linux_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: SteamOS 3 (Arch-based Linux, as used on Steam Deck) or Ubuntu 20.04+
  • Processor: AMD Zen 2 or Intel i5 (Quad-Core)
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: AMD RDNA 2 (Steam Deck APU) or equivalent
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Any OpenAL-, ALSA-, or DirectX-compatible sound device
  • Additional Notes: Runs at 60 FPS on Steam Deck with low to medium settings. OpenGL 4.3 required.

content_descriptors.notes:
includes mature themes and fictional characters expressing potentially offensive views.
It may contain:
– Verbal references to sexual activity and prostitution (no depictions)
– Fictional drug use involving substances unique to the game’s setting
– Occasional strong language
– Themes of social conflict and moral ambiguity
